name: Vanuatu
summary: Vanuatu has a Wills Act and received UK trustee law, but custom land cannot be left by will. No fixed heirship share was found. Foundation law and Hague Trusts Convention status are not confirmed. A 2023 Law Reform Commission review of wills law is under way.
family_claims: Not confirmed. The Law Reform Commission issued a 2023 issues paper on wills, probate and administration.
foreign_law_note: No conflict-of-law rule was sourced. Custom land cannot pass by will (court decisions); intestacy uses UK-derived Succession, Probate and Administration Regulation 1972, per a government brochure.
trust_note: UK Trustee law applies in part (administration of land by trustees). A Vanuatu trust statute was not found, so 'limited' is recorded. No foundation law found.
open_questions: Outcome of the 2023 Law Reform Commission review.
Whether a statutory trust regime exists beyond received UK law.
Foundation law and trust tax treatment.
